extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: golf cart for two, approx. 2.4 x 1.3 x 1.9 m (L x W x H incl. canopy), wheel diameter 0.46 m
extras.notes: front faces -Y; 4 wheels are separate objects with origin on the hub (rotate around local X to roll); steering wheel (golf-cart_steering_wheel) is a separate object with origin at its hub, it turns around the steering column axis; golf bag with pastel head covers on the rear rack; no brand, no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
